name: Icey – Only logged in
author: Icedor Johansson

sections.description:
Easily manage site access with automatic redirection of non-logged-in users to the login page, ensuring only authorized access.

Need to grant exceptions? Configure IP whitelisting in the plugin settings.

The built-in magic link feature simplifies login for customers and less tech-savvy users.

Localization

  • English (default)
  • Swedish (sv_SE)
sections.installation:
1. Download via the WordPress repository or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Go to the Plugins page and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete it from the Plugins menu.
sections.changelog:
1.0.13 – 2025-10-08

Tested support for WordPress 6.8.3

1.0.12 – 2025-10-08

  • Security: Replaced the predictable “magic link” key with a secure WordPress nonce.
  • Performance: Refactored code to prevent logic from running on every page load, improving overall efficiency.
  • Code Quality: Moved inline CSS to a separate, enqueued stylesheet as per WordPress standards.
  • Workflow: Moved plugin development and version control to GitHub.

1.0.10 (25-02-06)

  • Fixed missing .mo file requirement for Swedish translation (sv_SE).
  • Verified and corrected text domain usage for translation compatibility.
  • Ensured all user-facing text is fully translatable.

1.0.9 (25-02-06)

  • Added Swedish translation (sv_SE).
  • Implemented load_plugin_textdomain for multilingual support.
  • Adjusted plugin settings page text for better clarity.
